name: Network_proximity
description: Network proximity between two node sets (e.g. drug targets vs disease genes) on a user-supplied graph, via the Guney/Barabasi (2016) closest-distance measure with a degree-matched random Z-score. Give the network as inline 'edges' pairs or a 2-column 'edgelist_path', plus 'targets' and 'disease_genes' node lists. Returns closest distance, Z-score, empirical p, and random reference stats. Pure networkx+numpy, no network call or API key.

edges.description: Network as inline [source, target] node-id pairs (undirected). Use for small/medium graphs.

edgelist_path.description: Alternative to inline: path to a 2-column edgelist (.tsv/.txt = tab, else comma)

targets.description: First node set, e.g. drug-target gene IDs

disease_genes.description: Second node set, e.g. disease-module gene IDs
